ns2:course.label: Earth Materials and the Env
ns2:course.description: Studies the origin, identification, and environmental significance of earth materials (minerals, rocks, and soil). Environmental topics include: mineral resources; acid mine drainage; volcanic hazards; swelling soils; engineering strength, porosity/permeability, and architectural uses of earth materials; and asbestos. Required 1- or 2-day field trip. Field trip fee required. Same as ESE 333. Credit is not given for both GEOL 333 and GEOL 432. Prerequisite: GEOL 100 and GEOL 110; or GEOL 101, GEOL 103, GEOL 104, GEOL 107, GEOL 111, or GEOL 250; and CHEM 102 and CHEM 103; or consent of instructor.
